description: Raw convergence data: PEEC n_peri sweep + BEM-A mesh sweep on 3turnCoil_work_coil.step (2026-05-13).

geometry.description: 3-turn pancake helix R_avg~35mm + r_wire=3.15mm, 2 lead bars 60-61mm at y=+/-12.5mm

peec_convergence.description: PEEC perimeter filament count sweep (n_peri). Same STEP geometry, same lead-aware chain.

richardson_extrapolation_1_over_n_peri_l.method: Linear fit of L vs 1/n_peri using last 2-3 points

production_value.rationale: Panel default. ~1 s solve time vs ~88 s at n_peri=64; 1.78% under-prediction acceptable for engineering use.

bema_convergence.description: BEM-A (Weggler stabilized EFIE on HDivSurface RT0 + SIBC) mesh sweep via ngsolve.bem.LaplaceSL with use_fmm=False (dense LU).

unreachable.reason: Dense saddle LU (scipy.linalg.solve) OOM at K = 37429^2 = 22 GB; MINRES (scipy.sparse.linalg.minres, rtol=1e-8, no preconditioner) ran 107 min CPU and grew memory to 61 GB without converging.  Production-grade BEM-A above 10k tris requires HACApK/FMM acceleration.

bema_convergence.convergence_assessment: NON-MONOTONIC. 4028-tri value 432.57 nH coincidentally matches PEEC continuum (~434) but is not part of a monotonic refinement sequence. Of the 3 valid data points, 5938 -> 9848 shows monotonic drop from 417.56 to 412.18 (cap discretization improved 6/6 -> 14/14, refining the Lagrange multiplier space).

richardson_extrapolation_estimate.method: Crude 1/sqrt(N) and 1/N fits on 5938 + 9848 only -- 2 data points, large uncertainty
richardson_extrapolation_estimate.note: 4028-tri excluded as off-trend.  14972-tri needed to confirm.  Cannot make a confident statement of BEM-A continuum from current data.

R_coil_disparity.note: Mesh-independent. Points to formulation-level disagreement: PEEC uses Dowell analytical thin-skin formula for circular wire, BEM-A applies SIBC Robin BC on the surface with Z_s = 1/(sigma*delta). The two should agree in the thin-skin limit but diverge here.

candidates_for_inductive_disagreement: (i) PEEC parallel-transport frame + finite n_peri perimeter discretization of round wire
(ii) BEM-A SIBC accuracy at finite delta_skin/r = 0.054 (classical SIBC assumes infinitely thin skin)
(iii) Lead-bar / helix junction treatment differs across formulations
(iv) BEM-A non-monotonicity at 4028/5938 suggests under-resolved surface mesh

todo: Implement HACApK / FMM-accelerated path in coil_inductance_ngsolve.py::compute_inductance_source_sink to enable BEM-A above 10k tris.
Add block-diagonal preconditioner for MINRES (SL approx + Schur complement) to make iterative saddle-point solve viable on dense large matrices.

Investigate Dowell vs SIBC R-coil disparity: trace through the analytical derivations on a canonical straight round wire of length L, radius r, at 150 kHz; both methods should give identical R = L/(2*pi*r*sigma*delta) in the thin-skin limit.  If they disagree on this trivial geometry, the issue is a unit/normalization bug; if they agree, the 3turnCoil disagreement is due to curvature/junction effects.
